thought: This is a setting-focused prompt for the village environment in the Shanxi-Chahar-Hebei base area. The distinctive features are the mud-brick walls (土墙), thatched roofs (茅草屋顶), and courtyards with water vats. The emphasis is on the rustic, humble nature of this rural mountain village that serves as the backdrop for the 1941 wartime story. The prompt should capture the village's vulnerable simplicity and traditional construction while maintaining the desaturated earth-tone palette and dramatic lighting style.
prompt: Wide environmental establishing shot of a typical rustic mountain village in the Shanxi-Chahar-Hebei base area, 1941 autumn. Eye-level view showcasing traditional Chinese rural architecture with distinctive rammed earth walls in weathered ochre and dusty brown tones, thatched roofs made of bundled dried straw and millet stalks. Asymmetrical composition following natural village layout with clustered dwellings arranged organically along dirt village paths. Foreground featuring a traditional courtyard entrance with prominent large clay water vat (水缸) positioned beside the doorway, middle ground showing multiple single-story farmhouses with textured mud-brick walls, small wooden doors, and aged thatched roofing with visible layered straw texture, background revealing more village structures nestled against mountain foothills. Unpaved earthen village roads winding between buildings, scattered with small stones and dried autumn grass. Simple wooden farm tools leaning against walls, sparse chicken coops, modest vegetable plots. Overcast diffused autumn lighting creating soft shadows and emphasizing the humble, vulnerable nature of the settlement. Desaturated earth-tone color palette dominated by muted clay browns, faded ochres, dusty grays, dried straw yellows, and weathered wood tones. Solemn, austere atmosphere conveying the simplicity and precariousness of wartime rural life. Realistic heavily-painted 2D animation style with thick impasto brushwork, strong textural quality on mud walls and thatched roofs, pronounced light-dark contrast characteristic of historical war illustrations. Deep depth of field maintaining clarity from foreground water vats to background structures. Environmental documentary portraiture emphasizing authentic period architecture. Cinematic, subdued lighting with neutral-to-cool color temperature. Moody, historically-grounded aesthetic capturing the modest dignity of revolutionary base area villages.
